name: Squaricle Group
description: Squaricle Group is made up of several great brands, delivering training that makes truly great people. The Group was founded in 2020 as ted Learning Group and changed its name in June 2021.

brands.name: ted Learning
brands.description: ted Learning delivers both classroom-based, virtual and online learning using theatre-based learning, with professional actors and experienced trainers, for any form of training that involves human interaction.

brands.name: ted HuB
brands.description: The ted Learning HuB is a vibrant online learning community where clients' learners access their digital and virtual training, including pre and post-course work, plus free ted Express courses, podcasts, videos and insights.

brands.name: emerging-u
brands.description: emerging-u is a Leadership Learning and Development Agency that specialises in culture change, leadership development and team effectiveness.

brands.name: CurioTraining
brands.description: CurioTraining is an online workplace training brand offering practical, accredited courses for individuals, teams and organisations, with certificates included and easy team enrolment for managers.
